description: FEAT B (news ingest) + FEAT C (persisted DataSnapshot) + INFRA (compose/env/runbook). The NewsItem and DataSnapshot tables already exist (migrated in FEAT-002's revision 002); this feature adds their repositories/services, the forward-compatible lane sinks, and the infra stack + news-sources ToU doc. Design §6, §7, §8. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: backend/app/repositories/news_repository.py (§6.4): async recent_for_ticker(ticker, limit=10, as_of=None) with WHERE (ticker=:resolved OR ticker IS NULL) AND (:as_of IS NULL OR published_at <= :as_of) [INCLUSIVE — intentional asymmetry vs bars, §6.4] ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT :limit; and an insert path using postgresql insert(...).on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=['dedup_hash']). Provide a sync variant for the snapshot service.

backend/app/services/news_service.py (§6.1, §6.3, §6.5): RSS ingest via feedparser over config NEWS_RSS_FEEDS (primary, always-on); dedup_hash = sha256(f'{source}|{url or headline}|{published_at_iso}').hexdigest() full 64 hex; per-entry validation (headline+url+source required, skip else; unparseable published_at -> NULL); per-feed failure is non-fatal, return summary dict {added, skipped, failed_feeds}; raise NewsIngestError only if EVERY feed fails. BSE announcements via bsedata behind default-off NEWS_BSE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED with a `# TODO(step-2): verify bsedata announcements endpoint reachability & ToS, then enable` note.

docs/news-sources.md (§6.1 HARD deliverable): for EACH configured source document name, feed URL, terms-of-use/robots stance, attribution requirement, and the allowed-use note ('personal research, non-redistributed'). State the default NEWS_RSS_FEEDS value shipped in .env.example is a non-resolvable placeholder to be replaced with ToU-cleared feeds before any ingest run.

backend/app/services/snapshot_service.py (§7.2, §7.3): build_and_store_snapshot(ticker, as_of) -> (snapshot_id, payload), SYNCHRONOUS (uses the sync session + sync DataPipeline). Build the enriched daily frame via DataPipeline(ticker, interval='1d').get_enriched_data(end_date=as_of.isoformat(), interval='1d', lookback_days=200, use_cache=False) (now routed through MarketDataService by FEAT-002). snapshot_id via the IMPORTED backend.app.schemas.snapshot.compute_snapshot_id (NEVER reimplemented/forked). Idempotency: if a data_snapshots row with snapshot_id exists return (snapshot_id, row.payload); else INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (snapshot_id) DO NOTHING. Payload JSONB per §7.2: ticker, as_of, interval='1d', snapshot_tail_n=60, bars (last 60 enriched rows incl. indicator cols), indicator_summary (TechnicalIndicators.summarize(df)), headlines (news_repository.recent_for_ticker(ticker, as_of=as_of)); on news-source failure payload headlines=[]. Validate ticker non-empty, as_of a date, non-empty frame.

Lane sinks (§7.4): add a trailing optional param snapshot_sink=None to quant.recommend.recommend(ticker, as_of, df=None, snapshot_sink=None) and deep.adapter.analyze(ticker, as_of, portfolio=None, snapshot_sink=None). The computed snapshot_id and all existing behavior are UNCHANGED; when snapshot_sink is None (the only Step-2 case) it is a strict no-op. No Step-2 code passes a non-None sink — it is a forward-compatible seam for Steps 3/4. The existing call sites in tests/test_integration_slice.py (analyze('TEST',AS_OF), recommend('TEST',AS_OF,df=enriched)) must keep working unchanged.

infra/docker-compose.yml (§8.1): name: fintech-infra; services postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16, env POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB with fintrack defaults, ports 5432, volume pg_data, pg_isready healthcheck) and redis (redis:7-alpine, ports 6379, volume redis_data, redis-cli ping healthcheck); named volumes pg_data/redis_data. NO Ollama service (host route, decision 0002). NO backend/celery services in Step 2.

infra/.env.example (§8.2): POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB; DATABASE_URL (postgresql+asyncpg://...) and DATABASE_URL_SYNC (postgresql+psycopg2://...); REDIS_URL; OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434 + GATEWAY_MODEL/GATEWAY_NUM_CTX; NEWS_RSS_FEEDS set to the intentional non-resolvable placeholder (.invalid TLD) with the replace-before-ingest comment; NEWS_BSE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED=false.

docs/runbook.md (§8.3): append a 'Step 2 — data stack' section: cp infra/.env.example infra/.env; docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d (wait for healthchecks); from repo root with venv `... -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head`; smoke `... -m pytest -m integration -k price_bar`; teardown `docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down` (-v drops volumes).
acceptance_criteria: `docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config` parses without error and declares project name fintech-infra with services postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16) + redis (redis:7-alpine) and named volumes.
build_and_store_snapshot imports and calls backend.app.schemas.snapshot.compute_snapshot_id (verified by a grep + an import); it does NOT define its own snapshot hashing.
The offline suite stays green: default snapshot_sink=None is a no-op and the existing test_integration_slice.py call sites are unchanged.
docs/news-sources.md exists and documents each configured source's ToU + attribution + allowed-use.
A no-infra unit test for the dedup_hash function passes (same inputs -> same hash; differing url -> different hash).
verification: OFFLINE: `c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` — offline suite (incl. the new dedup-hash + payload-builder unit tests) green; the lane-sink default no-op keeps test_integration_slice.py passing.
`docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config > $null; echo ok` succeeds.

INTEGRATION smoke (stack up + migrated): `... -c "from backend.app.services.snapshot_service import build_and_store_snapshot; from backend.app.services.news_service import ... ; print('ok')"` and a single build_and_store_snapshot(golden_ticker, trading_day) returns a 16-char id and writes exactly one row. Authoritative dedup/idempotency integration assertions live in FEAT-004.
findings:
FEAT B (news) + FEAT C (snapshot) + INFRA all landed. Offline suite 59 passed (50 pre-existing + 9 new tests/test_news_snapshot_unit.py). No golden tickers materialized here (that is FEAT-004). No infra/network touched; integration/migration smoke deferred to FEAT-004 per this FEAT's verification note (Docker stores not brought up here, though `docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config` parses clean).

FILES ADDED:
- backend/app/repositories/news_repository.py: NewsRepository (async) + SyncNewsRepository (sync). insert_items -> pg_insert(...).on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=['dedup_hash']) returning rowcount of NEW rows. recent_for_ticker(ticker, limit=10, as_of=None): WHERE (ticker=:resolved OR ticker IS NULL) AND (as_of IS NULL OR published_at <= :as_of) [INCLUSIVE — intentional asymmetry vs bars' EXCLUSIVE ts<as_of, §6.4], ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST (sqlalchemy.nulls_last) LIMIT :limit. Shared stmt builders _insert_statement/_recent_statement used by both async & sync.
- backend/app/services/news_service.py: module-level compute_dedup_hash(source, url, headline, published_at) = sha256(f'{source}|{url or headline}|{published_at_iso or ""}').hexdigest() FULL 64 hex (unit-proven: stable for same inputs, differs on url, falls back to headline when url empty/None, handles missing published_at). _entry_to_row validates headline(trimmed)+url+source required else None; unparseable/absent published_at -> None (NULL). _parse_published uses feedparser's published_parsed/updated_parsed struct_time -> aware UTC datetime. NewsService.ingest_rss(feeds=None, ticker=None) -> {added, skipped, failed_feeds}; per-feed failure non-fatal (WARNING, counted in failed_feeds), raises NewsIngestError ONLY when EVERY configured feed fails. _parse_feed treats feedparser bozo_exception with no entries as a hard feed failure; malformed individual entries are skipped (counted). BSE announcements behind default-off settings.news_bse_announcements_enabled with the `# TODO(step-2): verify bsedata announcements endpoint reachability & ToS, then enable` note. feeds default to settings.news_rss_feeds.
- backend/app/services/snapshot_service.py: build_and_store_snapshot(ticker, as_of) -> (snapshot_id, payload), SYNCHRONOUS. Enriched frame via DataPipeline(ticker, interval='1d').get_enriched_data(end_date=as_of.isoformat(), interval='1d', lookback_days=200, use_cache=False) (routed through MarketDataService by FEAT A). snapshot_id = IMPORTED backend.app.schemas.snapshot.compute_snapshot_id (NEVER forked — verified by grep). Idempotency: select existing DataSnapshot by snapshot_id -> return stored payload; else pg_insert(...).on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=['snapshot_id']). Payload JSONB keys: ticker, as_of(iso), interval='1d', snapshot_tail_n=60, bars (last 60 enriched rows incl. indicator cols; NaN->None, ts iso), indicator_summary (TechnicalIndicators.summarize), headlines (SyncNewsRepository.recent_for_ticker with as_of=datetime.combine(as_of, time.max, tz=UTC) so an as_of-day headline is INCLUSIVE); on news-source failure headlines=[]. Validates ticker non-empty, as_of is date, non-empty frame. Module constants SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL='1d', SNAPSHOT_LOOKBACK_DAYS=200.

LANE SINKS (§7.4): quant.recommend.recommend now (ticker, as_of, df=None, snapshot_sink=None); deep.adapter.analyze now (ticker, as_of, portfolio=None, snapshot_sink=None). Trailing optional param; when None (only Step-2 case) it is a strict no-op and the computed snapshot_id + all behavior are UNCHANGED. When non-None it is called as snapshot_sink(snapshot_id, ticker, as_of, df) right after the id is computed. No Step-2 code passes a non-None sink (forward seam for Steps 3/4). Existing tests/test_integration_slice.py call sites analyze('TEST',AS_OF) / recommend('TEST',AS_OF,df=enriched) are UNCHANGED and still pass.

INFRA:
- infra/docker-compose.yml: name: fintech-infra; postgres (pgvector/pgvector:pg16, POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB fintrack defaults, 5432:5432, volume pg_data, pg_isready healthcheck) + redis (redis:7-alpine, 6379:6379, volume redis_data, redis-cli ping healthcheck); named volumes pg_data/redis_data. NO Ollama/backend/celery services. `docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config` parses clean; resolved name=fintech-infra, images + volumes confirmed.
- infra/.env.example: POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB; DATABASE_URL (asyncpg) + DATABASE_URL_SYNC (psycopg2); REDIS_URL; OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434 + GATEWAY_MODEL=llama3.2 + GATEWAY_NUM_CTX=8192; NEWS_RSS_FEEDS=https://example-business-daily.invalid/markets.rss (intentional .invalid placeholder w/ replace-before-ingest comment); NEWS_BSE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED=false. infra/.env stays gitignored (.gitignore has .env.* with !.env.example negation); only .env.example committed.
- docs/news-sources.md: HARD §6.1 deliverable. Documents allowed-use (personal research, non-redistributed) for all sources, flags the shipped NEWS_RSS_FEEDS as a non-resolvable placeholder to replace before ingest, provides a per-source ToU/attribution table + add-a-source checklist, and the BSE-announcements default-off TODO.
- docs/runbook.md: appended 'Step 2 — data stack' section (cp .env.example -> .env; docker compose up -d + ps wait for healthy; alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head from repo root; pytest -m integration -k price_bar smoke; docker compose down [-v]).

TESTS (tests/test_news_snapshot_unit.py, all OFFLINE, 9 cases): dedup_hash stability/url-difference/headline-fallback/missing-published; _entry_to_row validation + row build; _bars_payload tail-60 + JSON-safe (NaN->None) + shorter-frame-returns-all; constants guard. DB-touching paths (insert_items, build_and_store_snapshot persistence/idempotency, recent_for_ticker point-in-time) are the authoritative FEAT-004 integration assertions.

SEAM DETAILS for later FEATs: snapshot payload headlines use INCLUSIVE published_at<=as_of (datetime at end-of-day UTC). NewsRepository.insert_items returns count of NEW rows (rowcount after ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). NewsService.ingest_rss raises NewsIngestError only on all-feeds-fail. Lane sink signature is snapshot_sink(snapshot_id, ticker, as_of, df). No DB/Redis opened by the offline suite (sync engine stays lazy).
